# NewLife Marketing

> Ads-first digital marketing agency based in Barrie, Ontario, serving Simcoe County and the GTA. In-house paid media (Meta & Google Ads), SEO, social media, video/creative production, and CRM buildouts.

## Site

- [Home](https://newlifemarketing.ca/): Overview and entry point.
- [Services](https://newlifemarketing.ca/services/meta-ads/): Meta Ads, Google Ads, SEO, social media, creative production, CRM buildout, marketing software.
- [Industries](https://newlifemarketing.ca/industries/ecommerce-retail/): E-commerce & retail, home services & trades, local & storefront, professional services, health/fitness/wellness, real estate & hospitality.
- [About](https://newlifemarketing.ca/about/): Company background and team.
- [Blog](https://newlifemarketing.ca/blog/): Daily marketing articles.
- [Articles](https://newlifemarketing.ca/articles/): Weekly data-driven research pieces, byline "NewLife Research".
- [Contact](https://newlifemarketing.ca/contact/): Contact and booking.
